name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 4 - Am 99
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 4d. Recalls that housing policy is not a shared competence and must not evolve into one through secondary legislation, financial instruments or coordination mechanisms; stresses that any EU action must not result in the harmonisation of national housing systems; emphasises that Member States retain full sovereignty over the design, financing and regulation of their housing policies; calls on the Commission to ensure compliance with the principle of conferral and avoid competence creep;
